resources.string: Skillect is a global community for people aged 16 and above.
Connect your Supabase project in AI Studio Secrets (SUPABASE_URL & SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) to sync live global data.
Choose a new password for your Skillect account

OUR COMMUNITY Skillect is a place to learn create share ideas and build meaningful connections
RESPECT EVERY MEMBER Treat people with kindness and respect differences in background skill and opinion
KEEP PEOPLE SAFE Never threaten bully harass groom exploit or target another member
PROTECT YOUNG PEOPLE Sexual content involving minors exploitation grooming and requests for private images are not allowed
SHARE RESPONSIBLY Post content you own or have permission to share and respect privacy and copyright
NO HARMFUL CONTENT Do not share hate speech violent threats explicit sexual material self harm promotion or dangerous instructions
BE HONEST Do not impersonate others deceive members run scams or misrepresent your work
NO SPAM OR ABUSE Avoid spam fake engagement repeated unwanted messages and malicious links
RESPECT PRIVACY Do not publish private information or images without permission
REPORT CONCERNS Use the report option when something feels unsafe and provide clear details
FAIR REVIEW Reports are reviewed fairly serious violations may lead to content removal account restrictions or a ban members may appeal eligible decisions
